visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a light blue kindergarten uniform with a white collar and a yellow bucket hat waves enthusiastically at the camera against a plain white wall decorated with pink stars. Two bottles of AB Yogurt, one large and one small, sit on a rustic wooden table in front of him. (2) He gestures dynamically with his fingers, pointing upwards to signify specific numbers while maintaining an exaggeratedly cheerful facial expression. (3) The creator strikes a muscle pose to show strength, then points directly at the yogurt bottles as if recommending them. (4) He suddenly runs away from the table through a brightly lit hallway towards a dark brown bathroom door. (5) Standing inside a modern bathroom, he looks into the mirror, adjusts his yellow hat, and shows his face in a medium close-up. (6) He washes his hands under a chrome faucet with water flowing into a white ceramic sink. (7) The scene cuts to him in a sophisticated black turtleneck and black fedora, posing with a hand on his chin in a room filled with cardboard boxes. (8) He returns to the kindergarten persona, shaking his head and waving his hands in a dismissive 'no' gesture. (9) A close-up shot shows pink strawberry yogurt being poured from a bottle into a clear tall glass. (10) He holds up a purple aluminum can of Japanese cider, showing the brand logo clearly to the camera. (11) He pours the cider into the glass with the yogurt and uses a long-handled metal spoon to stir the mixture vigorously. (12) He takes a large sip and reacts with wide eyes and a look of intense surprise and pleasure. (13) He is seen laughing uncontrollably and leaning over a box in a messy interior space. (14) Back at the wooden table, he puts his hands together to form a heart shape around his face. (15) Close-up views focus on the white AB Yogurt bottle, showing the label details clearly. (16) He presents a green bottle of tea to the camera with a confident smile. (17) He demonstrates another mixture by pouring white yogurt and then green tea into a glass. (18) He tastes the new drink, smiles warmly, and gives a big thumbs-up. (19) He points his finger at the camera and then at the group of products on the table. (20) Finally, he holds both yogurt bottles against his cheeks, looking very satisfied and content as if ready for a nap.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic male voice shouts 'Hello everyone!' over a fast-tempo, synth-heavy pop BGM with a strong electronic beat. (2) The voice continues narrating a story about high school entrance exams with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone and very fast speech rate. (3) A distinct 'thud' SFX occurs as the scene transitions, followed by the sound of a toilet flushing. (4) A loud, distorted meme sound effect of a woman screaming and crying plays at a high volume level, creating a comedic effect. (5) The sound of water splashing from a faucet is clearly audible, accompanied by the muffled sound of hands scrubbing. (6) The voice shifts significantly to a lower, deeper, and more 'cool' professional tone, speaking slowly with confidence. (7) Upbeat music resumes as the original high-energy voice returns, sounding slightly hurt and defensive. (8) A liquid pouring sound occurs (glug glug), followed by the high-pitched clinking of metal against glass as a spoon stirs. (9) The sound of loud swallowing is followed by a sharp 'pop' SFX and a joyful exclamation. (10) A background track of a group of people laughing loudly plays for a few seconds. (11) The narration picks up speed again, explaining recipes with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. (12) More liquid pouring and stirring sounds are interspersed with the upbeat BGM. (13) The voice becomes slightly calmer and more melodic towards the end, summarizing the health benefits of the products while the music fades out slowly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution/Product Demonstration -> Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short-form advertisement designed to promote AB Yogurt. It utilizes a high-energy, meme-style editing format where a creator plays a childlike character who demonstrates creative '特調' (special mix) recipes—specifically mixing yogurt with Japanese cider and green tea. The intent is to show the product's versatility and health benefits for digestion in an entertaining way that appeals to a social media audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator shows the products directly to the camera, explains their benefits for digestion, provides specific mixing recipes, and mentions that they can be purchased at 7-11.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends entertainment with advertising through its use of trending meme aesthetics and fast-paced editing.
